_readme: Edit this file once a year when the Department of National Registration publishes a new registered population figure. Both pages read it.
base_source: Registered Maldivian population, end of 2025. Department of National Registration, published by the Maldives Bureau of Statistics (Statistical Yearbook, table 3.4).
growth_source: Average yearly growth of the Maldivian population between the September 2014 census (344,023) and the September 2022 census (382,751).
